eps.d: Maggie and Andrew are looking forward to an early retirement in France, but fate has other plans in store.
Maggie and Andrew have been looking after their grandchildren for just 12 hours and one's already in casualty. The social services are suspicious.
Maggie and Andrew find that trying to enjoy their grandchildren isn't much fun.
Both the grandparents and the grandchildren are finding living conditions cramped, but Maggie and Andrew have a cunning plan to expand.
Maggie mistakenly thinks that school days are going to be the happiest of her life as the new term starts for her three orphaned grandchildren.
Maggie and Andrew decide they should legally adopt their three grandchildren, but the news doesn't go down too well.
Maggie discovers that the family has forgotten Georgia's birthday and organises a secret party.
Maggie takes on Jake's teacher who is giving him nightmares with tales of global pollution.
When the children buy Maggie a puppy for her birthday she is less than thrilled.
It's Jake's school sports day so Maggie and Andrew go along for support.
Maggie and Andrew take their grandchildren on a camping holiday in France. But will the lure of the chateaux prove too much for Maggie?
Maggie and Andrew plan a quiet, romantic evening for their wedding anniversary. Then the family from hell arrive.
Maggie wins a trip to a theme park, but would rather settle for the quiet life and a crate of wine.
Maggie has flu. Andrew reassures her that he can handle everything, but it's not long before the rot sets in.
Maggie and Andrew are accused of embarrassing their grandchildren in public.
Maggie feels superfluous when the children all go to Andrew with their problems. So she decides to leave home.
Maggie becomes a cub mistress and Andrew has a reunion lunch withhisformer secretary. But when Rosie tries to arrange forthe Prentices to win a car in the raffle, Maggie faces a moral dilemma.
When the Prentices take a family holiday on a narrow boat, Andrew draws up a duty rota. As his only "duty" appears to be acting as captain, it is not long before the crew are plotting mutiny.
Georgia announces that she is fasting for world peace but Maggie is worried when she doesn't start eating again.
Maggie discovers that her neighbours are moving because her household is too noisy. Philip is unhappy that Maggie and Andrew plan to jive at his school dance.
When Maggie and Andrew discover Philip is having trouble from a school bully, they decide to visit his parents.
